title: A clip refused by a track of the wrong kind says why, not "no room"
goal: Carrying a clip (or several picked clips) onto a track that cannot take it, such as picture onto a sound track or anything onto a locked track, makes the readout under the hand say "no room on Audio", as if something were in the way. An editor then looks for a clip to move that is not there. The words should name the real reason in a short label.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-05 by Scripts/playtest/several-picked-clips-change-track-walk.json step 49 (dragClip Tutorial Sample tracksUp -1): log note "aimed no room on Audio, refused"; picture queue/audits/2026-10-05-several-clips-change-track-5-refused-on-sound-sc.png. The single clip drop says the same (EditorState+Tracks.swift clipTrackDropReading: drop.allowed ? "to name" : "no room on name"). ClipTrackDrop only carries allowed: Bool; it needs a reason (kind / locked / overlap) from canPlace / canMoveClips.
acceptance: Carried onto a sound track, a picture clip reads a short label that says the track takes sound only (30 characters at most), not no room
Carried onto a locked track it says the track is locked
A real overlap still reads no room on <track>
A walk holds each of the three and reads the words

log.note: adversarial pass: an editor told no room hunts for a clip in the way; now kind is said before lock (unlocking would not help), and with several picked clips the track named is the one that refused, which can be a different lane from the one under the hand (asked in the audit). Left rough, not filed: moving one recording clip alone onto a new V2 split the sound onto a new Audio 2 lane (seen in the walk; existing behaviour, not a refusal, nobody reported it); long graphic track names can push the words past 30 chars, as before.

Refused drops now say why: PhotonzCore ClipPlacementRefusal (wrong kind / locked / no room) for one clip and several picked clips; capsule reads 'Audio takes sound only', 'V2 is locked', 'no room on V2'. dragClip walk step gained 'reads'; several-picked-clips-change-track-walk holds all three and passes at Next defaults with 9 real captures. Full suite green (11517 tests). Audit queue/audits/2026-10-06-refused-drop-says-why.json. Commit 44719376.
